scope: bounded independent review of proof-scope snapshotting, compiler observations, formal audit inventory, strict shard integration, and workflow artifact retention
cleanup_failure_artifact_caveat: If remove_dir_all fails, old files can remain, including an old complete summary, and the workflow's always-running artifact upload can retain them. No new success summary is produced and the strict job fails; consumers must not treat artifacts from a failed job as successful proof evidence.
explicit_limits: Endpoint snapshot equality does not detect inputs changed and restored during execution.
External compiler, dependency, macro, solver, and trusted status-producer authority remain separate trust work.
CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR data context intentionally requires disjoint package roots and package-local static source references.
Compiler selection is not proof discharge and does not establish full production correspondence.
The dirty local app-runner checkpoint is not final committed proof and was not used as acceptance evidence.
This review did not run a full-workspace proof capture because unrelated agents were modifying agent and quality Rust files.
